proposals.detectability_argument: Skips the first modular subtraction exactly when the pre-reduction sum equals 2*mod, leaving the partial product unreduced by one modulus -- reachable (e.g. mm_p == mod_r - 1 with mm_add == 2) but rare under randomized stimulus.
Reads the wrong exponent bit when deciding whether to follow a square with a multiply-by-base, corrupting the result for essentially every exponent whose top two bits differ.
